messages:
Olivia: Heads-up — starting bring-up for rwd-v3.2-int8 into hosted catalog. Quick sanity results: ~25% throughput uplift, ~2.3x cost reduction vs fp16, p95 latency +3ms. But we see a fidelity delta on long-doc MRR (~1.8% drop). Proposing a staggered canary with slope-back auto-fallback. Looking for concrete gate numbers and config examples.
Sam: Can you paste the small report and which slices regressed?
Olivia: Perf snapshot: p95 123ms -> 126ms, throughput 800->1000 req/s in our sim, cost/1k tokens down ~58%. Regression slices: long-docs (>2k tokens), nested-code blocks (triple backticks), and some legal contract Q&A prompts. I attached the eval IDs in the console.
Maria: I suggest start 1% traffic for 24h, then linear ramp to 10% over 48h. Metrics to watch: long-doc MRR, hallucination rate (checkout detector), kv-warmup miss rate. Auto slope-back rules: if MRR delta > 1.0% OR hallucination rate increase > 0.5% over baseline in any weighted slice, step back to previous stable model.
James: Add an entropy-aware gate too — if per-slice token-entropy z-score exceeds 2.0 for two consecutive windows (1h), trigger rollback. Also keep full shadow compare at 100% for 48h to surface nondeterministic diffs.
Olivia: Drafting canary config now. Example snippet: ```json
{
  "canary": {"start_pct": 1, "ramp_to": 10, "ramp_hours": 48, "min_hours_at_pct": 24},
  "gates": {
    "mrr_delta_pct": 1.0,
    "hallucination_pct_increase": 0.5,
    "entropy_zscore": 2.0
  },
  "actions": {"slope_back_steps": [5,2,1], "rollback_to": "rwd-v3.1-fp16"}
}
```
Sam: Also run targeted eval jobs (longdoc subset + codegen specially instrumented) every 2 hours during the canary and post results to the /eng-ml thread. If any eval fails the gate, set canary to hold and notify owners.
Maria: Agreed. Add a promotion guard: require at least 20% cost improvement AND no MRR regression >0.5% across critical slices to promote automatically. If cost improvement under 20% we should require an explicit rollout approval.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by olivia — start 2024-06-12T15:00Z, canary_id=c-1718204567, target route=/models/rwd-v3.2-int8, initial_pct=1
Sam: Put a quick dashboard with the longdoc MRR time-series and per-slice z-scores. Also log top 20 failure prompts if a rollback triggers.
Olivia: Will do. I'll post the canary config in the repo and link the dashboard. If rollback happens we'll include the delta table and top 5 offending prompts in the incident note. :thumbsup:
Maria: Nice. One more ask — enable kv-cache warmup diagnostics and include warmup hit-rate in the gating signals (threshold <85% triggers a review, <70% triggers auto-hold).
Olivia: Good call. Adding that to the config and the alerting rules. Will update here when scheduled runs start.
James: Thanks — ping me if we need stricter holds for legal-slice traffic.
Olivia: Will do.
